afc6dd932fef8e0c714ad47ef855545324685eb1.summary: Adds a /fork slash command that copies an idle chat's transcript, mode, model and skills into a new independent tab, in VS Code chat and the browser workspace via a new /api/tabs/fork route.PR-free of approvals and checkpoints.</parameter>

974a85c526a5bbcf09537e2ae2c35c4443d82aca.summary: You can now run /fork on a chat that is still running; the fork snapshots it as if stopped at that moment, marks unfinished tools and pending questions as interrupted, skips queued messages, and /fork from the slash menu now runs immediately.

c29a228a6fb04607e4e05a73f91445eb224b2a58.summary: The Desktop Assistant view now draws inside the desktop's own sidebar and title bar (violet theme, shared sidebar width, title-bar reload button) instead of showing a second title bar and sidebar, with a fallback for sign-in and older servers; pairing page spacing is also tidied.
